# Evidence and Recovery Checklist: Grounded answer workflows

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review for provider trust, durable recovery and evaluation.
**Created**: 2026-11-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by speckit-checklist for this slice.
**Review Ownership**: Reviewer-owned requirements-quality artifact; owner-authorized autopilot includes review assistance.
**Marker Semantics**: A checked criterion means reviewed requirements quality, not completed implementation.

## Authority and completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are membership, tenant, freshness, quote and source-time authorities specified separately? [Completeness, Spec FR-002]
- [x] CHK002 Are quote/paraphrase semantics and the limit of structural validation explicit? [Clarity, Spec FR-003]
- [x] CHK003 Are finite response, duration, claim/citation and repair limits required? [Completeness, Spec FR-004]
- [x] CHK004 Are route persistence, credential privacy and no-fallback rules consistent? [Consistency, Spec FR-001, FR-007, FR-008]

## Recovery and provenance

- [x] CHK005 Are cancellation, restart, duplicate execution and unknown publication outcomes covered? [Coverage, Spec FR-008]
- [x] CHK006 Is current versus stale/unknown behavior specified at both publication and readback? [Coverage, Spec FR-009]
- [x] CHK007 Are immutable history, retry linkage and export provenance defined across all supported backends? [Completeness, Spec FR-008, FR-010]
- [x] CHK008 Are direct evidence queries independently usable during provider failures? [Consistency, Spec FR-005]

## Evaluation and release

- [x] CHK009 Are duplicate, contradiction, unanswerable and withheld-evidence corpus cases required? [Coverage, Spec FR-011]
- [x] CHK010 Are metric denominators, pass criteria and retained failure examples required separately from fluency? [Measurability, Spec FR-012, SC-004]
- [x] CHK011 Is real-model election and unverified-result reporting explicit? [Clarity, Spec FR-013]
- [x] CHK012 Are release recommendation, PR publication and owner merge boundaries unambiguous? [Consistency, Spec FR-015, FR-017]
